message: 器としての資格
The heavy burden placed upon my heart fades away.
Lolotte accepted even my feelings of remorse.
We are both angels--yet I feel ashamed that I mistakenly believed myself to be a sublime being even among our kind.
With this, everything I am has come to an end.
Even after losing everything, a warm presence still welcomes me.
For the first time in my life, I was forced to realize my own weakness.
A weak existence, falling far short of Lolotte, who descended to the Human World without regard for her own safety.
If I do not inherit the will of Re―Crea, I am merely an ordinary angel―doomed to spend my life like an empty shell without a will of my own.
Can living while being driven by something else truly be called "living"?
The wish I desire right now. That is--
To return to Heaven, receive just judgment, and atone for my sins.
I had hoped that once all of that was settled, I could walk alongside Lolotte.
Yet, however.
Next, I ended up betraying my master.
Lolotte forgave me.
However, my master would never forgive me.
Even if I try to avert my eyes from the will of execution, it tries to correct me.
Ever since anomalies began occurring in my body, doubts must have been swirling within me.
Not an ill effect of materialization, but a turmoil of emotions running counter to my master's will.
Even curling up my body does not allow me to escape the agony.
My body creaks, and my skin grows burning hot. A pain so severe I can barely even breathe assails me.
Holding back sobs, I can only wait desperately for the time of punishment to pass.
There was no way I could shake it all off.
Until I lost my qualifications as my master's vessel……
